map.输入任意两个已知量，自动计算第三个量。适用于匀速直线运动估算。: Enter any two of speed, distance and time to solve the third for uniform-motion problems, with selectable speed units.
map.公式：s = v × t。本工具假设匀速直线运动，实际运动若含加速过程请使用其他: Formula: s = v × t. This tool assumes uniform linear motion; if acceleration is involved, use another kinematics tool.
map.请确保至少输入两个有效数值，第三个留空。: Ensure at least two valid numbers, leave the third empty.
map.结果基于匀速直线运动模型，适用于粗略估算。: Results are based on the uniform-motion model, suitable for rough estimation.
map.行程规划中按距离与限速估算所需耗时。: Estimate travel time from distance and speed limit in trip planning.
map.d=120 km、t=2 h → v=60 km/h；t=1.5h 同距 → 8: d=120 km, t=2 h → v=60 km/h; same distance at t=1.5h → 80 km/h.
map.v=d/t 为全程平均，瞬时需导数。: v=d/t is the whole-trip average; instantaneous needs a derivative.
map.注意 km/h 与 m/s 的换算关系：1 m/s = 3.6 km/h。: Note the km/h ↔ m/s relation: 1 m/s = 3.6 km/h.
map.速度、距离、时间是运动学中最基础的三量关系。本工具支持根据任意两个已知量快速求解: Speed, distance and time are the most basic three quantities in kinematics. This tool quickly solves the third from any two knowns.
map.匀速直线运动三量互求：缺 v 时 v = s ÷ t、缺 s 时 s = v×t: Uniform linear motion with three mutually solvable quantities: without v, v = s ÷ t; without s, s = v×t (requires t >0); without t, t = s ÷ v (requires v >0); speed can be switched to km/h (= m/s × 3.6). Validation: fewer than 2 valid values (non-numeric or negative counts as invalid) prompts "Please enter at least two valid values." Grading: with all three filled, a consistency check is run — distance computed as v×t is compared with the input s; a deviation <0.001 is marked consistent (green), otherwise it is flagged in yellow with the deviation.
